newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suspected Corsican separatists shoot at barracks.
newsitem.headline: Suspected Corsican separatists shoot at barracks.

text.p: Suspected Corsican separatists sprayed bullets on Sunday at a paramilitary police barracks in Bastia on the northern tip of the French Mediterranean island, police said.
No one was hurt and no one immediately claimed responsibility for the attack just before dawn. Several gendarmes were working in the building at the time.
Sixteen marks of bullets from an automatic weapon were found on the facade of the Montesoro barracks, the fourth such attack in three years against the building.

The outlawed Corsican National Liberation Front, pushing for the past 20 years for more autonomy from Paris, stepped up threats against gendarmes on Wednesday, urging them to evacuate their families from Corsica and stop "derisory patrols".
President Jacques Chirac reaffirmed government pledges of a crackdown on the guerrillas in a television interview on Thursday.
